about: Every visual stage of the battles, oldest first: milestones, review rounds and fixes. scripts/timeline.mjs (track "battles") turns this into timeline.gif. Add a stage with every visual commit; never overwrite a stage's picture. A commit cannot name itself, so the newest stage says "next" until the following commit fills in its hash.

stages.title: B2 · Style frame
stages.note: Google Flow art at full resolution: a sword squad against its red twin on the meadow.

stages.title: B2 r1 · Men and women
stages.note: A woman leader and soldier from Flow: Aria leads, and both squads mix men and women.

stages.title: B2 · Animation test
stages.note: Round 2: Aria's attack from pose images with a code-drawn smear, beside the same attack from a Veo 3.1 clip.

stages.title: B2 r1 · Motion between poses
stages.note: The same poses with breathing, eased lunges, a hit-stop, screen shake and dust; a victory pose.

stages.title: B2 · Bram, the first new leader
stages.note: Standing image from Google Flow, 10 poses from Seedream; a spear thrust with a straight streak.

stages.title: B2 · Edric, the first rider
stages.note: A mounted knight: horse and rider pose together, a four-pose gallop, a lance charge.

stages.title: B2 · Corin, the axe
stages.note: An overhead chop with its own arc; one pose regenerated, sizes matched to the stance.

stages.title: B2 · Dela and Ilse, the ranged heroes
stages.note: An arrow and a magic bolt drawn in code; the six player heroes are done.

stages.title: B2 · The rival army's six leaders
stages.note: Varek, Sabine, Gorran, Petra, Ulric and Morwen: Flow standing images, Seedream poses, their own swings, streaks, arrow and crimson bolt.

stages.title: B2 · The twelve soldiers
stages.note: A man and a woman for each class: Flow standing images, Seedream poses, their own swings, streaks, arrows and pale blue bolts; soldiers stand smaller than leaders.

stages.title: B3 · The squads take the field
stages.note: Any matchup in the battle scene: each side's leader and its soldiers in formation, men and women in turn, the enemy's soldiers recoloured red in the shader; riders in two looser ranks.

stages.title: B3 · The battle plays out
stages.note: The rules decide and the scene plays it: the charge, the counter, the duels, panic and flashes, falls, the winners' cheer and the Morale lost; the HUD follows live and Space skips to the result.

stages.title: B3 r1 · Opposite numbers, and Morale in the ranks
stages.note: Head fights head and soldier fights soldier until one falls, then the free fighters spread over the soldiers left and reach the head last; a wounded unit brings fewer soldiers; the fallen fade back to lie at their own places.

stages.title: B3 · Stance and the skill gauge
stages.note: A, S and D set the player's stance from the next beat; each banner shows its edge; the skill gauge fills as blows land, half again as fast when aggressive and not at all when passive.

stages.title: B3 · From the map and back
stages.note: A foe on the next tile is marked in bold red; a click opens the battle over the board, and Space comes back to the same view with the loser's Morale down. At 0 Morale a unit leaves the field.

stages.title: B4 · The hand of cards
stages.note: Each turn opens on a hand of 8 cards in the map's menu style: name, POW, MOV and ACE, and the focused card's skill above. The card played sets the shared MOV pool; used cards are greyed and stamped.

stages.title: B4 · One battle a turn, and the foes' turn
stages.note: The battle fights at the card's POW and ends the turn. The foes' turn shows for 1.5 s in a red box with the card they play, then the next turn opens on the hand.

stages.title: B4 r1 · Long Road's card art
stages.note: The first animated card's art, in layers: a dawn road plate, Aria and a sword soldier from their standing images, and a milestone and straw grass in front, made by Seedream through the API ($0.14) and composited by cardart.py with a contact shadow and a depth map.

stages.title: B4 r2 · The animated card
stages.note: Long Road as a layered 3D card at full resolution: the layers part as it tilts toward the pointer, dawn beams breathe, dust drifts, a glint runs along Aria's sword, holographic foil slides over the gold, and a click flips it to its crested back. The foes' cards are crimson and silver.

stages.title: B4 r3 · The hover clip, three models
stages.note: Long Road’s hover clip made by Seedance 2.0 Mini, Fast and 2.0 from the same still, prompt and seed. Mini zooms out and ends off the still, so it would jump when the card fades back; Fast and 2.0 loop back to it. Fast’s clip is installed until the user picks. Spent $1.75 on the three.

stages.title: B4 r4 · All twelve cards
stages.note: The other 11 cards made the same way as Long Road: Seedream layers from the units’ standing images, composited by cardart.py, each with a Seedance 2.0 Fast hover clip that loops back to its still. Each card now has its own light (daylight, mist, a storm break, a fire aura, firelight, torches, lightning, moonbeams, candles) and rain falls in streaks. The round spent $10.46 of the $12 cap.

stages.title: B4 r5 · The hand of animated cards
stages.note: The B4 pixel menu hand is replaced by the animated cards, drawn on a canvas of their own at full resolution over the board. They fan along the bottom; the card the pointer is on rises, tilts and plays its clip; F or a long press turns it over; spent cards are greyed and stamped. On the foes’ turn their card slides in face down on crimson stock and turns face up. On a phone the chosen card lifts clear above the row.

stages.title: B5 · Unions
stages.note: A unit attacks with its Union: the allies on its shape (a + for a woman, an × for a man) are marked violet when it is selected, with the shape’s empty places edged. Attacking, it fights first, then each member fights the same foe in turn, every battle in full and labelled UNION 2 / 3, the foe carrying its Morale losses down the chain until it falls or the Union runs out.

stages.title: B6 · Card skills
stages.note: Each unit now carries a skill gauge from battle to battle. When it is full and the unit wields the card’s ACE, the battle holds at its opening with a guide: K fires the skill, Space saves it. Firing plays a cut-in with the card’s own clip and the skill’s name, then the effect: Forced March’s +3 edge, Firestorm’s blast, and nine more, with a hit-stop and shake where a skill’s blow lands. King’s Wager fills every ally’s gauge as it is played.

stages.title: B6 r1 · A slower cut-in, the card in focus
stages.note: The skill cut-in lasts 4.2 s instead of 1.9: the battle dims, the band is taller and the card’s clip plays about 40% larger, the skill’s name easing in beside it, before the flash. K, Space or Enter skips it.
